issue.title: Update: PHP Configuration Cheat Sheet - session settings deprecated in PHP 8.4
issue.body:
## What is missing or needs to be updated?

The session block in the PHP Configuration cheat sheet sets `session.sid_length = 256` and `session.sid_bits_per_character = 6`, and the "paranoid checks" block sets `session.referer_check`. PHP 8.4 deprecated changing all three of these INI settings, so following the sheet on a current PHP version produces deprecation warnings and the settings are going away. See the Session section of https://www.php.net/manual/en/migration84.deprecated.php, which says to keep the default 32 character hex session IDs and stop changing `sid_length` and `sid_bits_per_character`.

A few other lines in the same file look stale too, like `mime_magic.magicfile` and some removed functions (`filepro*`, `dbase_open`) in the `disable_functions` list.

## How should this be resolved?

Drop the `sid_length`, `sid_bits_per_character` and `referer_check` lines and add a short note that the defaults are the supported setting from PHP 8.4 on, since the default ID already has enough entropy. While in there, clean up the settings and function names that no longer exist in supported PHP versions. I'm happy to open the PR.

comments.body:
Thanks for the detailed report, @cvas22. You're right that the session block and the paranoid-checks block still recommend settings that PHP 8.4 deprecated, and that some directives and function names in the file no longer exist in supported PHP versions. This update makes sense, and we'd welcome your PR. The linked pull request was closed, so please open a new one (or reopen it) when you're ready, and we'll review it.

2996.title: Update: PHP Configuration Cheat Sheet - session settings deprecated in PHP 8.4
2996.body:
The session block set `session.sid_length`, `session.sid_bits_per_character` and `session.referer_check`, and PHP 8.4 deprecated changing all three. I removed them and added a short note to leave the session ID settings at their defaults, citing the PHP 8.4 migration notes. I also dropped `mime_magic.magicfile` and `allow_webdav_methods`, which aren't in PHP's INI list any more, and the `filepro*`, `dbmopen` and `fopen_with_path` entries from `disable_functions`, since those functions don't exist in current PHP.
